## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (unit + realism + fuzz)
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes (desktop + iPhone)
- [ ] Bug fix? Added a regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Model constant changed? Source/rationale added to `RESEARCH.md`; realism tests run with a few seeds
- [ ] Athlete input added? Followed the maintenance matrix in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- [ ] Visible UI change? Regenerated screenshots (`npm run docs:screenshots`) and updated `docs/TUTORIAL.md`
- [ ] No cookies, third-party requests or default storage (privacy rules)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
